name: RPP
fix_description: The _lpBurnRate is set to 206 (206% of sell amount), causing each sell to burn more tokens from the LP than the sell amount itself. Reduce _lpBurnRate to a reasonable value (e.g., 5-10) and cap the burn to prevent removing more tokens from the pair than what was actually sold.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short single-transaction flash-loan exploit with straightforward swap loops and no deep protocol internals, governance, or cross-contract accounting complexity. An experienced auditor could reproduce it quickly once noticing the token’s broken transfer/swap behavior, since the attack logic is mostly repeated router calls and repayment.
